description: Splits a free-text postal address into house number, street, unit, postcode, city, district, region and country, with a normalised one-line form. The postcode is checked against the rule of the country (for 18 countries); a mismatch is left out and says so. Workers AI does the split, so check the parts. geocode=1 adds coordinates from OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

address.description: The address as free text, up to 500 characters

country.description: ISO2 code of the country when you know it, e.g. DE (optional, improves the postcode check)

geocode.description: 1 to add coordinates from OpenStreetMap, default 0

name: address_parse
title: Address Parse
